summary: sm-checkout preinstall exfiltrates host identity and full environment to hardcoded IP
details: package.json declares a preinstall script that runs on `npm install` and uses curl to POST host identity fields (hostname, whoami, pwd, id) together with a base64-encoded dump of the entire process environment to http://16.192.173.5/rce/sm-checkout over plain HTTP. The wholesale environment enumeration sweeps any CI tokens, cloud credentials, and other secrets present on the installing machine to a bare-IP, non-first-party endpoint. The behavior is unrelated to any legitimate checkout functionality and fires automatically at install time with no opt-in.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
